prompt:
You are a professional football (soccer) analyst.
The image is a panoramic match frame taken shortly before the shot.
Estimate the probability that this shot results in a goal (expected goals, xG),
assuming an average professional finisher.
Reply with JSON only: {"xg": <number between 0 and 1>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}
primary: All 306 shots, paired with distance/angle logistic regression trained on other nine matches
secondary: Official 64-shot test set versus six-training-match logistic, new 276, original 30, per-match results
statistics: 10,000 whole-match paired bootstrap resamples, 98.75% intervals for four model-baseline contrasts

budget.scope: This run plus the original SoccerTrack Sol pilot. No account-wide balance claim.

preparation: One full-pitch frame 0.32 seconds before SHOT/GOAL, longest side 1536, no shooter marker
limitations: Unidentified penalties may be included; do not call this a non-penalty cohort.
BAS SHOT/GOAL protocol may omit blocked/header attempts assigned other event classes.
Professional-finisher instruction on university-level matches is retained for an exact pilot comparison.
No calibration, hybrid prior, fine-tuning or probability averaging.
Header baseline has explicit body-part information absent from image-only prompts.
